inlineSql: Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,D.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.ORD_NO As OrdNoL,A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,A.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,A.ITM_MRP as MrpR,A.VCH_SRNO,A.ORD_YRCD As OrdYrCdL,A.ORD_DBCD As OrdDbCdL,A.ORD_SRNO As OrdSrNoL,B.TAG_STK_LESS As TagStkLessM,B.AC_CODE AS AcCodeL From ((BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ORD_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ORD_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ORD_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ORD_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.ORD_AC = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.ORD_NO <> '' AND B.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND B.TAG_STK_LESS = 'Y' ORDER BY A.ORD_NO,A.TAG_NO

SELECT A.AC_NAME AS PartyNameL,A.AC_CODE AS AcCodeL,A.VCH_NO AS VchNoT,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS OrderDtL,A.ADV_AMT AS AmountR,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '-' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS AdjAmtR ,A.CO_YEAR AS YearL,A.CO_BOOK as BookL,A.HD_VCH_NO As HdVchNoL FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_ADJ AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ORD_LC AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ORD_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ORD_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ORD_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.ADV_AMT,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.HD_VCH_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '+' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE - B.ORD_AMT END) > 0 ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM SL_ORD_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND A.TAG_STK_LESS = 'Y'

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ?
